landing.disclaimer: Illustrative interface; no live session or service metrics.
landing.description: KELEDON is an autonomous inbound agent that handles calls, navigates web interfaces, and executes workflows while keeping people in control.
landing.transcriptExample: “I need to check my case status…”
landing.featuresDescription: KELEDON coordinates voice, cloud decisions and browser execution through workflows configured for each client.
landing.audioFeatureDescription: Captures supported browser audio for the speech provider configured by each client. Platform compatibility requires client-specific validation.
landing.decisionFeatureDescription: Cloud workflows use the configured model, managed prompts and validated output contracts to determine next steps.
landing.automationFeatureDescription: Executes approved browser actions within configured client origins and validates required outcomes.
landing.securityFeatureDescription: Cloud decisions and local browser execution use tenant permissions, scoped credentials and bounded diagnostics.
landing.architectureDescription: The cloud decides which policy and workflow actions to take. The browser executes approved actions in the interfaces configured by each client.
landing.browserAgentDescription: Provides the audio and deterministic execution surface for approved workflows in client-configured call and CRM interfaces.
landing.cloudBrainDescription: Handles model inference, state management and retrieval from your knowledge base.
landing.caseClassificationDescription: Example workflow: classify a conversation and prepare structured information for a client-approved destination.
landing.caseSupportDescription: Example workflow: consult an authorized knowledge base and prepare a support response or a configured ticket action.
landing.caseOrderDescription: Example workflow: capture an order reference and execute a configured lookup after validating the client workflow.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to transform your contact center?
landing.ctaDescription: Configure KELEDON for the call and CRM interfaces your organization uses, then validate the workflow with a controlled pilot.
